evidence: Touches src/net.cpp, src/net.h, and src/net_processing.cpp to change peer discouragement handling for private broadcast connections; carries the P2P label.
rationale: Fixes a privacy leak and connection stability issue where discouragement of private broadcast connections could be observed externally or cause operator-configured connections to drop due to other misbehaving subnet peers. Reviewers note that 'whatever happens in a private broadcast connection shouldn't alter the state of the node in such a way that this change can be observed from outside' and emphasize backporting to 32.x.
